facts.fact: 本章主角是 Benjamin Heavy Runner——他追上房车并上了车，但这一切本不在他计划内。
facts.anchor: Benjamin bared his teeth, hissed. Stepping up into this RV was not in his plan.

facts.fact: Seine 被附身后爬到货架上方，抓着黑色货网像抓牢房的栏杆，眼神狂乱。
facts.anchor: She was up on the one-person sleeping shelf, was holding the elastic slats of a black cargo net like the bars of a prison, her eyes wild, hair coming out of its braid, lips dry and crusted.

facts.fact: Mooch 认出 Benjamin——他就是当年被 Mooch 的兄弟们带去喝酒、被丢在湖边的那个人。
facts.anchor: “I remember you,” Mooch said back, staring right into his soul. “You’re the one my brothers took out drinking that time, left at the lake.

facts.fact: Benjamin 用后视镜当武器，狠狠砸中 Seine 的左太阳穴，把她打晕。
facts.anchor: he reached up, wrenched off the first thing his hand could clamp on, and, holding it sideways, popped her fast and hard on the left temple.

facts.fact: Mooch 用强力胶把 Seine 的手掌粘在天花板上，防止她再扑下来。
facts.anchor: Mooch was already standing back up on the booth to smear the eye-stinging glue over Seine’s left palm and the undersides of her fingers. Then she pressed that palm hard to the ceiling

facts.fact: Seine 的肚子里鼓起一只旧式拉环啤酒罐——那是 Benjamin 十六岁第一次上保留区时喝的第一罐啤酒。
facts.anchor: What it came back with, pressing it up against her belly like offering it to him, was a beer can, the top of it, rising, rising, the skin thinning out over it

facts.fact: Benjamin 在床垫下找到那本 Seine 坚称不在赃物里的笔记本。
facts.anchor: It was the notebook Seine assured him hadn’t been in the stolen goods that had come in with the ransackers.

facts.fact: 结尾：Nate Yellow Tail 赤着上身、满脸干血、哭着跑上路边，追上房车。
facts.anchor: Jogging up the shoulder, falling once but getting back up, shirtless, one side of his face crusted with dried blood, his mouth open like he was a child, crying, was Nate Yellow Tail.
